I will keep to the pattern I know best here in Quzhou County: winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land. That is the safest way for me to farm at my age. I know the timing, I know the field work, and the local land, water, and weather fit this rotation. I do not want to spread myself across too many crops, because that raises labor and risk. I will keep the area moderate, use improved wheat seed and hybrid maize seed, apply fertilizer in a simple steady way, irrigate when the crop really needs it, and control weeds, insects, and disease with a limited number of pesticide sprays. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and faster for me than deep ploughing, and it matches how I would manage residue and seedbed preparation. My aim is steady grain yield with work I can still handle myself.
